feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 29 August 2026 10:35pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 29 August 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure lies to the west of Ireland, bringing a frontal zone tomorrow.


##Wind##

Mainly northwest 2 to 4, soon becoming south or southwest 3 or 4, occasionally increasing 5 in the south of the area from tomorrow morning. Backing south or southeast for a time tomorrow evening.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers overnight. Then occasional rain or showers tomorrow afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain and showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the south of the area. Gradually veering west or northwest 4 or 5 overnight into Monday, and increasing 5 or 6 for a time on Monday morning and afternoon, then occasionally decreasing 3 in places later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate for a time.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
